scope: streaming multiband for the unpublished forward-drizzle-v2 prototype: profile production contract, halo/ring residency, reuse-aware read amplification, fusion parity, confidence calibration, matched-star validation and raw/uniform fallback. Library-level; production runner wiring stays with Gate 10.

profile_production_contract.shared_clip_mask: exactly one Gate-3 reservoir sigma-clip decision per (native pixel, channel) is shared by all four profiles; Q values never enter the clip decision
profile_production_contract.candidate_quality_means: per-candidate q_c/q_0/q_1/q_a are the geometric K-averages over the frame's droplets: sum(area_j * clamp(q_j,0,inf)) / b_src; a NaN/<=0 source Q contributes 0 (explicit veto, not a fallback); a missing stream yields 1.0
profile_production_contract.artifact_flag: qa_has_data iff sum(area_j over finite q_a samples) > 0
profile_production_contract.alpha_contributions: per accepted candidate {b, q_c, q_a (NaN when no data), is_direct, residual_factor} feed compute_alpha_confidence_channel semantics; per-frame {g_eff, is_direct, residual_factor} arrive via a device frame-meta table indexed by frame order
profile_production_contract.profile_outputs: per profile: value = sum(w*x)/sum(w), weight_sum = sum(w), n_eff = sum(w)^2/sum(w^2); support only where the profile weight sum > 0
profile_production_contract.fallback: reservoir overflow / too-few-candidates fallback emits the uniform stream value for every profile and zero alpha factors

kernel_layout.reservoir_side_array: float4 {q_c, q_0, q_1, q_a} per kept slot, qa<0 sentinel encodes !qa_has_data; allocated only when emit_profiles
kernel_layout.frame_meta: 16 B per frame {g_eff, is_direct, residual_factor, pad}, uploaded per accumulate call
kernel_layout.bounded: single reserve() allocation batch, zero hotpath allocations, unchanged frame streaming

halo_ring_contract.fusion_input_halo_internal_rows: multiband_fusion_halo_rows(levels) = 2*(2^levels-1) + energy_guard_window_radius(levels) + 2, evaluated on the v2 output grid; levels=4 => 64 rows
halo_ring_contract.ring_semantics: a committed output band is immutable once every input band inside its vertical halo is finalized; resident finalized bands = floor(2*halo/band_rows)+2 worst case
halo_ring_contract.immutability_point: fused core rows of band b become immutable when the last band overlapping [b_lo-halo, b_hi+halo] is finalized and committed
halo_ring_contract.x_tiles: a-trous is separable 2-D: an X-tile additionally needs the same halo in columns; the v2 default stays full-width bands (Gate-5: feasible down to ~2 GiB device)
halo_ring_contract.resume: no transient halo state is persisted; a resume reloads the persisted finalized band artifacts covering the overlap window (sichere Wiederanlaufueberlappung, section 18.2 option 2)

reuse_aware_read_amplification.problem: Gate-5 conservative RA counts each band's (2h+1) padded read fully; halo 62 fails the RA bound
reuse_aware_read_amplification.model: with band-edge reuse the application layer reads every needed source row once plus one halo pad per image edge: application_source_bytes = H*W + 2*halo_src*W (first band top pad), independent of band count
reuse_aware_read_amplification.counters: source_reused_bytes / quality_reused_bytes count the overlap rows served from the retained predecessor tail instead of a fresh read
reuse_aware_read_amplification.gate: reuse-aware application RA <= 1.1 required for the selected tile plan

fusion_decision.rationale: fusion consumes finalized, persisted band records already on host; it runs once per band, not per frame, so its cost is a small fraction of drizzle; a device port would add a second clip-adjacent code path without a memory or latency need
fusion_decision.contract: fuse_multiband_streamed on v2-produced profile planes must be bit-identical to fuse_multiband on every supported pixel except the documented B3 flood-fill stripe-boundary pinch
fusion_decision.support_preservation: fused support subset of (U coarse AND all R bands valid); multiband never widens support
fusion_decision.revisit: a device fusion port may be re-decided at Gate 10 if measured fusion seconds violate the run-time budget

confidence_calibration.v2_factor: the Gate-4 per-pixel bounded confidence in [0,1] replaces the Q_p90-Q_p50 separation factor: a_separation_v2 = clamp01(confidence) channel-min over active channels
confidence_calibration.a_artifact: from the qa stream via the plan-14.4 weighted p10 smoothstep over clip-accepted contributions (unchanged semantics)
confidence_calibration.a_registration: from the per-frame {is_direct, residual_factor} table over clip-accepted contributions (unchanged semantics)
calibration_gates: clean synthetic field with high n_eff and modeled sigma2 => a_separation_v2 >= 0.9
degraded field (low n_eff or all-invalid sigma2) => a_separation_v2 <= 0.1
globally near-zero alpha is reported as its own diagnostic, never as a silent success

matched_star_and_fallback.module: multiband_validation select_reconstruction_candidate reused unchanged on v2-produced images
gates: zero effective multiband stars block a positive multiband selection
multiband equal to raw fails the FWHM ratio at equality and selects Raw
raw failing an applicable safety gate falls back to Uniform
uniform and raw remain immutable controls measured at matched star positions

memory_amendment.notes: reservoir side array +1024 B/px (64 slots x 16 B), five f64 frame planes +480 B/px over the gate-6 footprint; non-profiled mode is unchanged. The Gate-5 plan bound is amended for profiled mode only.

test_matrix.profile_parity: v2 device profiles vs CPU oracle on scale 1/2, MONO/OSC, uniform-Q identity, Q veto (NaN/<=0), missing streams, g_eff!=1, clip-shared mask, overflow fallback
test_matrix.ring: immutability point, resident band bound, first/last band edges
test_matrix.reuse_ra: formula vs padded model, halo 0/14/62, counters
test_matrix.fusion: v2 adapter + streamed vs whole-frame parity, stripe-boundary caveat, support subset, levels 1..4
test_matrix.confidence: clean/degraded calibration cases, channel-min, near-zero-alpha diagnostic
test_matrix.validation: matched-star gates on synthetic v2 images incl. zero-effective-star and alpha==0 cases

fusion_grid.rationale: the Gate-2 fold produces one candidate set per native pixel; the legacy internal-resolution profile planes are not available in v2 and reproducing them would violate the fold contract
fusion_grid.consequence: at internal_scale=2 the same level count covers half the physical frequency reach of the legacy internal-res fusion; band semantics are a documented delta, arbitrated by the matched-star validation gates rather than bit-parity to the legacy pipeline
